subject: [PATCH 25/60] mm/mempolicy: queue only common memory for mbind() and migrate_pages()

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch series is being reviewed, but no comments or feedback have been provided yet.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to optimize memory policy by queuing only common memory for mbind() and migrate_pages(). The change involves converting ZONE_DEVICE checks to use folio_is_common_memory(), ensuring that skipped folios do not count as failures. This approach is similar to how ZONE_DEVICE folios are handled, where they are not reported as failures even if MPOL_MF_STRICT is set.
